notes: 1.45.16: Batch C cua yeu cau 'PHF AI phu he sinh thai PHF HR' - lich su hoi thoai luu ben vung (truoc gio 100% chi o RAM client, chua tung luu server-side - tinh nang HOAN TOAN MOI). Schema moi (scripts/PHF_AI_CONVERSATIONS_1.45.sql, kem rollback scripts/ROLLBACK_PHF_AI_CONVERSATIONS_1.45.sql) - 2 bang ai_conversations/ai_conversation_messages, dung dung convention hien co (uuid pk, account_id text, trigger phf_touch_updated_at, RLS enable + revoke anon/authenticated, khong policy public - chi backend service_role doc/ghi). Khong luu system prompt/tool registry/secret vao lich su. Da chay npm run check/git diff --check/node --check truoc khi bump. Bump ?v= cho phf-ai-sandbox.css/phf-ai-engine.js/phf-ai-floating.js/phf-ai-sandbox.js (4 asset browser thuc su doi noi dung) sang 1.45.16_ai_history_batch_c; lib/ai-conversations.js va api/ai/conversations.js la server-side, khong qua browser cache-busting. | 1.45.15: Batch A+B cua yeu cau 'PHF AI phu toan he sinh thai PHF HR' - gop 1 ban vi 2 batch cung cham lib/ai-sandbox.js (vong lap tool-calling) va lib/ai-tool-registry.js (registry), tach thanh 2 commit se de lai 1 commit trung gian khong chay duoc. Tool doc moi: lib/ai-training-tools.js, lib/ai-classroom-tools.js, 3 tool Checklist con thieu, search_knl_people.
